claims.evidence: The classifier signature was checked against the repeated generated-name and mixed-case-token structure in recent Roadman contact notifications. Detection requires both synthetic signals, except for the isolated honeypot.

editorial.evidence: No public copy changed. The existing contact subjects, labels, response expectations and confirmation language remain intact.

offers.evidence: No product, membership, pricing, availability or contact-response offer changed in this release.

desktop.evidence: Codex inspected a full-page render of the changed route at 1365 × 900. The form and all surrounding content rendered without an error overlay or horizontal overflow; the honeypot was outside the viewport.

pages.observations: Heading, response cards, name, email, subject, message and submit controls were visible and aligned. Document width equalled viewport width, and the hidden website field began at x=-10000.

mobile.evidence: Codex inspected a full-page render of the changed route at 390 × 844. The form stacked correctly without an error overlay or horizontal overflow; the honeypot was outside the viewport.

pages.observations: Information cards and every genuine-contact control fit the mobile page. Document and viewport widths were both 390 pixels, and the hidden website field did not intersect the viewport.

interactions.evidence: A representative genuine sponsorship enquiry was completed in the browser with /api/contact intercepted locally. The request contained the expected name, email, subject and natural-language message plus an empty website field, received HTTP 200 and rendered MESSAGE SENT without external side effects.

seo.evidence: The contact route metadata and visible copy are unchanged. The branch SEO QA workflow passed on commit 0efdbf3.

technical.evidence: Seven focused classifier and API tests, TypeScript, focused ESLint and 56 publication-gate regression tests passed. The Vercel preview compiled, type-checked and generated all 4,470 routes; its later upload exhausted disk with a 3.6 GB output on a cacheless preview build, not in application compilation.
